question: Who won the International Booker Prize in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banu Mushtaq & Deepa Bhasthi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Banu Mushtaq & Deepa Bhasthi** won the International Booker Prize in 2025 for their collaborative work, which has been recognized as a significant contribution to global literature.
 
• The International Booker Prize is awarded annually to a book translated into English and published in the UK or Ireland, with the prize money shared equally between the author and translator.
 
• The winning work by Banu Mushtaq & Deepa Bhasthi explores themes of identity, displacement, and cultural resilience, resonating with readers across linguistic and cultural boundaries.
 
• The jury for the International Booker Prize comprises prominent authors, critics, and literary figures who assess the shortlisted works based on originality, literary merit, and global impact.
 
• This recognition highlights the growing influence of South Asian authors and translators in international literary circles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Samantha Harvey**

 
 
• Samantha Harvey is a British author renowned for her works such as "The Wilderness" and "The Western Wind."
 
• Her novels often delve into themes of memory, morality, and existential questions, earning her several literary accolades but not the International Booker Prize in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Geetanjali Shree**
 
 
• Geetanjali Shree, an Indian author, won the International Booker Prize in 2022 for her novel "Tomb of Sand," translated by Daisy Rockwell.
 
• This historic win marked the first time a work originally written in Hindi received this prestigious award.
 
• Her works explore themes of feminism, partition, and post-colonial identity, but she did not win the prize in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Vincenzo Latronico**
 
 
• Vincenzo Latronico is an Italian author and translator known for his literary and philosophical works.
 
• While his contributions to literature are notable, he did not win the International Booker Prize in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme: The International Booker Prize**
 
 
• The International Booker Prize celebrates translated works of fiction, promoting cross-cultural understanding and appreciation.
 
• It underscores the importance of translators in bringing literary masterpieces to a global audience.
 
• The prize has significantly contributed to the recognition of diverse voices in literature from around the world.
